title: Apparent molar volumes and heat capacities of aqueous magnesium chloride and cadmium chloride at temperatures from 278.15 K to 393.15 K at the pressure 0.35 MPa: a comparison of ion-ion interactions
authors: T. G. Call, K. Ballerat-Busserolles, M. L. Origlia, T. D. Ford, E. M. Woolley
experimental_method: Vibrating-tube densimeter (Anton Paar DMA 512) for densities and a twin fixed-cell power-compensation temperature-scanning calorimeter (NanoDSC 6100) for heat capacities, giving V_phi and Cp_phi of MgCl2(aq) at 0.35 MPa, calibrated with 1 mol/kg NaCl(aq) and water.
uncertainties_stated: +/- values per cell in the tables (standard deviations of repeated readings / scans); authors estimate maximum total random uncertainty as 4 x the printed +/-; density reproducibility within 18 ug/cm3; T controlled within 0.005 K; p = 0.35 +/- 0.015 MPa for the calorimeter.
quality_remarks: Uncertainties at m = 0.008 mol/kg are large (V_phi up to +/-0.7 cm3/mol; Cp_phi up to +/-22 J/(K mol)), scatter in V_phi at the lowest molalities is visible. Temperature scale not stated.
